coordinate_system.note: Coordinates are measured against the supplied final reference images. Only front-side fields are dynamic.

back.note: No dynamic fields. Preserve the supplied back-side artwork exactly as provided.

static_elements.signature: existing signature in front template — do not modify

rendering_rules: Do not change the final client-approved artwork, layout, dimensions, typography, colors, logo, icons, borders, or static text.
Do not add Member ID because it is not present as a field on this final template.
Do not make any back-side field dynamic.
Photo must be cropped to the photo rectangle without stretching.
QR must be generated dynamically from member.verification_url and must fit entirely inside the front QR placeholder.
Valid Upto must be generated as exactly one calendar year after issue_date, not 365 days.
Use the JSON rectangles as the single source of truth for dynamic placement.
Do not scatter hardcoded coordinates throughout the codebase.
Before export, validate that text does not overflow its assigned rectangle.
